items.title: Roy McCurdy interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, November 16, 1995
items.q: I think he was with Joe Romano.

ctx.x: I think his son is playing now too.
Yeah, yeah. So he’s one of those guys that was on the tour that we did. I think he was with Joe Romano.
